name: Fenclozic Acid

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market in United States and United Kingdom, first in 1970 — for liver harm

summary: Fenclozic Acid was pulled from the market in the United States and the United Kingdom, starting in 1970, because it harmed the liver [3]. Rather than using tests on people, a small computer model was used to calculate risk scores for this drug [M]. This computer model gave the drug a score of 77 for liver harm, which falls into the high category, and a score of 28 for heart harm, which falls into the low category [M].
